original.statement: In 1.16, L7 network policy with terminatingTLS no longer loads the ca.crt key from the secret, so Envoy no longer requires client certificates; set --use-full-tls-context=true to retain the old behaviour.

decision.reason: [ev-b5190a359c10] says L7 network policy with terminatingTLS will no longer load `ca.crt` from the secret, even when the key is present. That is a change in TLS handling under the same policy configuration, so behavior-changed on a protocol-behavior subject is the right reading. The name terminatingtls-ca-crt-loading is built from the evidence's own key words. The `--use-full-tls-context=true` flag is only the opt-out for keeping the old behaviour, not the thing that changed.
